tei:div.tei:p: (577)༄༅// rta nag yang phyung nag po'i zhi ba'isbyin bsreg thugs rje'i snang ba zhes bya bzhugs so/ (578)

spyan ras gzigs dag dbyer med pa/ rta mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal te/ zhe ba'i las kun grub pa'i phyir/ sbyin bsreg rim pa spel bar bya/ rgyud las/ dbyibs dang kha dog mtshan ldan par/ zhal du gyur pa'i me bos la/ bza' btung bro ba'i tshogs rnams kyis las bzhi'i mchod pa rab tu sbyin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dpal rta mgrin nag po lcags ral can gyi sgo nas drag po'i sbyin bsreg bya ba'i tshul gzhung las dngos bstan dang*/ zhar la zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg bya ba la gsum/ sgon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes sau/ dang po ni sa'i cho ga bya ba la/ gang du bya ba'i gnas rung shes par bya ba rnal 'byor pa lha'i snyem 'chang bzin pas cha gsum btang*/ pa'i lha mo la dkar gtor dang ner spyod bsham nas/ a kā re sa brlabs te/ skyob pa (579)shākya seṅge yis/ bud sde mngon par bcom pa'i tshe/ dpang gyur sa yi lha mo khyed/ gtor ma bzhes la sa 'di slong*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ sogs kyis phul rjes/ badzra muḥ sa gshegs/ rdo rje dang bcas pa'i tal me sa la reg ste lha'i nga rgyal gyis rtsa sngags kyis sbyag ba gsu gyis sa bzung*/ sa gzhi yang rang bzhin bden med du nges pa'i chos nyid la dran pa nye bar bzhag ste/ shu n+yā ta 'i sngags brjod bden pa gnyis kyis sa sbyangs nas/ gis pa dngos gzhi la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni bkra shis pa'i sa stegs tha thu bzi byas pa'i steng du/ thab khung zlam po rgyar bru gang ba/ dasang khu phyed long nas phyir 'phyang*/ ུ ran rgya dasangs por bzi ba re'i kha khyer nang du bags kyis gzhol ba la rdo rje'i phreng ba dang mu ran la me ris (580) bskor/ thab gyi dbus su ral dri dkar po rtse mo shar du bstan pa sor brgyad pa yu bar hūṃ yi ga gis mtshan pa/ stogs bu'i zur bzir zla phyed rdo rje mtshan pa bya/ yang bri thab ni/ stogs bu'i steng dri bzang dang ba byung lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga rnams chang dang sbyar bas chag chag bya/

de'i steng du tshangs zur gyi thig btab/ dbus nas mtho gang zlum por bskor nas rgyar gru gang long ba'i phyi rol por bzhire bskor bas mchu dang kha khyer gnis kyi nang ma rdo rje'i phreng ba dang phyi ma me ra/ zur bzhir zla khyer rdo rje/ lte bar ral dri dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ 'o ma cag gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha'am/ dgon pa'i ba lang gi lci ba srog chags med pas thabs kyi sangs tshad tsam du zlum por rtsegs pa'i shar ldor mi tshag bca'/ thabs sdogs kyi grwa bzhir mda' bzhi btsug pa srad bu dkar po bsnol mar sbrel mdar dkar po dgab/ de'i shar lho'i zur du mda' dar dmor gzug me yab dkar po/ thab gyi mdun du rang nyid 'dug pa'i stan dkar zhing 'jams dang*/ g.yas phyogs su stegs bu keb dkar po dang ldan pa'i steng du/ ba las byung ba'i mar khu dang*/ 'o ma tsan nam/ ba lu'am lcags ma logs pa'i rung mthun gyi shing gi rtse mo'i cha las byung ba'i yams shing mtho gang ba'i rtse mo mar khus byugs pa/ ti la dkar/ zho zan/ 'bras (581) po ba/ nas yungs dkar/ sran ma/ gro/ wa/ ku sha/ shig tog sogs dkar po las byug ba/ chan sogs kha zas dkar po dang*/ tsan ldan dkar po logs pa'i dri bzang dadagar po'i rigs dang*/ tsam pa ka logs pa me gtog dkar po'i rigs/ ri nam tshon logs pas btsos nas dkar po byas pa rnams dzin pa dag ye shes sa tha dad du phying nyis gtor ma zlum po ri la bu gang yang gis bskor ba gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang zhabs bsil sogs nyer spyod rnams rang bzhin bcos pas dkar ba dang*/ nye log ci bde bar las bum/ rdo dril/ thod rnga/ dgang blugs/ thugs dam bskul ba'i rdzas yungs dkar rin cen dkar po'i snod du byugs pa rnams ma tshang ba mder bsham mo/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis/ dang po bdag bskyed sngon 'gro san bzung bzlas pa'i bar du bya ba las gzhung ltar btang*/ las bum/ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/

shu n+yā ta sa sbyangs te/ stong pa'i ngag las las thams cad pa'i bum pa rin po tsha'i gzhal med khang tshad dang mtshan nanyid thams cad tshang ba'i dbus su sad zla'i gnad la hūm̐ las khro bo (582)bdud rtsi 'khyil pa ljajang ser g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon thugs par sdig mdzub can khro zhig sgegs pa/ bzhas cing 'jum pa'i mdangs can khro bo'i chas thams cad dzogs pa'i gnas gsum du rdo rje gsu gyi yi ges mashan pa/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes sa spyan drangs dam tshig sa la gnyis med du thim par bsam la/ oṃ badzra sa mā hūṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam hoḥ tiṣṭha badzra st+waṃ/ arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las mchog rdo rje bdud rtsi'i rnam par 'khyil/ bgegs kyi tshogs kun 'dzoms mdzad pa/ bdud rtsi 'khyil la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces dang*/ khro bo'i thur nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hūṃ gi mtha' bskor du sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas su 'akor ba las bdud rtsi ljang ser gyi rgyun babs te bum chu la thim par dmigs te/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla slar mchod cing bstod te/ khro bo'i dbong 'od du zhu nas bum chu la thim pas chu'i rdul phra rab re re nas bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skur gyur nas las (583)rnams sgrub bsam mo/ gnyis pa sbyin bsreg gi las la 'jug pa ni/ rang nyid chas gos dkar po dang ldan par lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas bzhin pas stan la rdo rje skyil krung gis 'khod de zhi zhing byam pa'i sesam kyis/ rdo dril bsad sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngag las hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje thab kyi rang bzhin ye shes lnga'i ngo bo dang*/ a las byung ba'i dril shreb gyi rang bzhin stong nyid chos dkayi sgra sbyangs sgrog pa gnyis ka'ang don dam pa'i byang chub sems ki rang bzhin no/ oṃ ma hā badzra hūm̐/ zhes pas g.yas kyi rdo rje thugs kar gsor zing*/

oṃ badzra ghaṇṭe a/ zhes g.yon pas dril bu 'khrol zhing dkur brten/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā a nu ra ga ṇa badzra swa bhā wa arma ko3 haṃ/ zhes thabs shes gnyis med kyi don dran par byas te thus kar 'khyur rgya bya'o/ de san mchod rdzas brlabs pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ 'phros/ sogs nas sman raka gtor ma rnams las byag bzin brlabs/ bsreg rdzas rnams la bsang sbyangs bya te/ stong pa'i ngang las ma dang a las nyi zla'i ga'u'i snod du bsregs rdzas (584)rnams rang rang gi mig yig dang po thig les brgyan pa 'od du zhu ba las bung ba'i bdud rtsi'i dngos po so so'i las sgrub pa la thogs pa med pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i rgyas reg la/ oṃ swā hā: rdzas rnams brku/ yam shing la/ oṃ a swā hā/ zhun mar la/ oṃ shrī swā hā: 'bru rnams la/ oṃ dzeṃ swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā ha'/ 'bru gsum dag rdzas sngags rnams lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab po/ thab bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du bhrum̐ yag 'phro 'du yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo'i lto ba la gnas pa'i zhi ba'i tab khung dkar zhing zlum la kha khyer la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer dkar po 'apro bar gyur/ rang gi thugs ka nas ram̐ yig thab nang du spros pa las ye shes kyi me 'od dkar po 'bar bar gyur/ oṃ agne ye dzwa la dzwa la hūṃ phaṭa/ gyis du ba mder 'bar ba'i me g.yas su bskor nas thab tu bcug hūm̐ brjod cing rlung g.yab gyis me sbra/ oṃ agne swāhā/ blugs gzar gyi mar khu'i (485)thigs pas gos/ oṃ badzra kro dhahaya gṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes bzlas/ ku sha/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zing dge/ tshangs pa lha rnams dag byed yin/dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed pa/ sa las skyes pa'i 'dab ma'i snying*/ bdag gi bgegs rnams thams cad ni/

zhi zhing bkra shis mdzad du gsol/ swā hā/ zhes thab gyi khar g.yon nas barma ste g.yas skor du bkram/ de nas me lha bskyed pa ni/ thab kyi dbus su ma dang diḥ las ra skyes kyi gdan la oṃ yig dkor 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/agne de wa ri ṣi hūm̐/ zhi ba'i me lha dkar po zhi zhing 'dzum pa drang srong gi cha byad can gundhe bsgrang phreng 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ de'i spyi bor oṃ badrin par āḥ thus kar hūṃ yig gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa bzhengs bar bsam agni de wa sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ zhes po gol bsnol mar gdab/mda' dar dmar po g.yab cing rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bong rna bdag yas pa'i rtsar g.yab sa sbud pa'i phyag rgya yin pas/(586) hūṃ: dad pa dag ni dam tshi gis/ tshur gshegs tshur gshegs 'byung po che/ me lha drang srong bram ze mchog 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol/ agni de wa ri ṣi dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ bam hauḥ sa bstim/ las sngags kyis phyir 'brag gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ sogs nyer spyod kyis mchod/ ji ltar basma pa sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes bum chus gtor/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i dbang gi lha mos byang chub sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa thogs pa spros te dbang bskur bar gyur/ oṃ ratna a laṃ ka ra swā hā/ ces rgyan btags par bsam/ de nas me lha cung zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dang gzar bu gnyis kyi kha la ram̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam/ oṃ agne ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ mar khu blugs gzer bdun gyis bgang ba'i dgang gza gyi zag mchu las babs pa'i mar khu bdud rtsi'i dngas mar drangs te gsol bas dgyes shing tshim par bsam la/ oṃ agni de wa ri ṣi ha bya ka bya dī bya bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon ldig sgrib bar tshad mi mthun (587)pa'i phyogs thams cad shin tam ku ru swā hā:

zhes gsum gyis dgang blugs bcakang se gang gzar kha sbyar ba pus mo las phyir mi 'da' bar g.yas su bskor te phul/ de nas rdzas rnams rim par 'bul bani/ yam shing*/ agni ye oṃ bho dhi briksha ya swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i gzi brjid phun tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shin tu ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du mar khu/ oṃ agni ye swā hā/ bdun dang*/ dbyor ba phun tshogs pa la= sogs gong bzhin/ til/ oṃ sarba pā saṃ da ha na badzra ya swā ha'/ sdig pa thams cad sbyang ba phun tshogs pa= zho zan/ oṃ sarbasaṃ ba de swā hā/ bde ba phun tshogs pa la= 'bras oṃ badzra puṣpa ya swā hā/ bsod nams phun tshogs pa= so ba/ oṃ badzra bī dza ye swā hā/ nor dang 'bru phun tshogs pa= nas oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ myur ba'i shugs phun tshogs = yungs pa dkar la/ oṃ sarba artha siddhi ya swā hā/ bgegs kyi banyen po phun tshogs pa= sran ma/ oṃ mhā ba la ya swā hā/ stobs phun tshogs pa= gro/ oṃ (588)badzra ghasma ri ya wā hā/ nad med pa phun tshogs pa= durba/ oṃ badzra la yu ṣe swā hā// tshe ring ba phun tshogs pa la= ku sha/ oṃ a sra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ bsrung ba phun tshogs = shing thog oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bhi lo ki te swā hā/ rigs rgyud dag chos rgyud phun tshags pa= gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor ba/ oṃ agni de wa ri ṣi ha bya ka bya dī bya bahna ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces sngags kyis phul te/ hūṃ: tshangs pa 'jig rten myon gyi sras/ me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog 'byung ngo yongs su sgrub bo pa'i phyir/ thugs rjes dbang gis sku sprul pa/ rig sngags sgrub pa'i drang srong tshul/ nyon mchogs sam bsregs pa'i shib 'od bskal pa'i me bzhin gzid 'bar/ mngon shes rdzul zhabs dang ldan/ thabs kyis sprul pa thag pa chibs/ bsgrang phreng 'dzin cing rig sngags gsung/ bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan gandhe bsnams/

chos kyi bdud rtsid yongs la bsil/ nyen pa'i skyon spang tshangs par spyod/ 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das (589)zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che/ de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes bstod la yungs dkar thab tu 'thor zhing*/ na mo/ rig pa'i rgyal po khyod kyis las thams cad byed pa bsregs rdzas rnams lhī zhal du 'bul ba dang*/ me nyid ye shes kyi mer byin gyis brlabs nas bdag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de nas ya shes kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa ni/ swā hā wa sa sbyangs nas/ me lha'i sto ba yangs shing rgya che ba rdo rje bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su/ oṃ badzra kro dha hya gṝ wa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes brjod pas skad di bdag gis gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du dbang chen rko bo rta mgrin sku mdog mating nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sogs mdun bskyed kyis gsal btab nas spyan 'dren nas bstod pa'i bar grub nas dag gang blugs 'bul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha cug zad 'dzum pa'i ljags dag zar bu gnyis kyi kha la hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa/ ljags rdo rje (590)'od kyi sbu gu can gyis bsregs glugs kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun drangs nas gsol bas dgyes nas thugs kī hūm̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer mkhyab tu 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pas dgyes pa bskyed/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs ste/ khyad pa ra gang la dmigs bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib tams cad 'od dkor bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis sbyangs te dag cing zhi bar bsam/ oṃ badzra kro dha hya gṝ wa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces la gsum gyis bskor bzhin phul rjes/ hūṃ: zhe sdang do rje 'khor dang bcas pas/ 'jig rten khams ni rab byams kun/ yud tsam gyi ni zhi mdzad pas/

zhi mdzad mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ zhes dang*/ yaksha nag po nṛ tri hur thum dzaḥ sogs sngags brjod nas/ bdag cag don slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ de nas rdzas rnams rim bzhin 'bul ba la/ yam shing rtsa sngags la/ oṃ bo dhi briksha ya swā hā/ lan bcu'am nyer gcig gi mthar las sngags kyis phul te/ bdag cag dpon slob (591)'khor dang bcas pa'i gzi byin phun tshogs pa la bar du gcod pa thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhesapa 'og ma rnams la 'gros te/ mar khu la rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ a mṛ ta khā hi/ las sngags kyis phul te/ 'byor pa phun tshogs pa la= til/ rtsa sngags la/ oṃ sarba sā paṃ da ha na badzra ya swā hā/ las sngags mthar/ sdig pa thams cad sbyang ba phun tshogs pa= zho zan rtsa sngags/ oṃ sarba saṃ ba de swā hā/ las sngags skyes phul te/ bde ba phun tshogs pa= 'bras rtsa sngags dag*/ oṃ badzra puṣṭa ya swā hā/ las sngags kyi phul te/ bos sam phun tshogs pa= sob rtsa sngags/ oṃ badzra bī dza ya swā hā/

las sngags kyis phul te/ nor dang 'bru phun tshogs pa= nas rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā be ga ya swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul te/ myur ba'i shugs= yungs dkar rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ sarba yarthasiddhi ye swā hā/ las sngas kyis phul te/ bgegs kyi gnyon mongs phun tshogs la= sran ma rtsa sngags/ oṃ ma hā ba la ye swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul/ stobs phun tshogs pa= rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ badra hasma ri me swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul te (592) nad med pa phun tshogs pa= durba rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ badzra a yu ṣe swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul te/ tshe ring ba phun tshogs pa la= ku sha rtsa sngags dang*/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badzra ya swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul/ bsrung ba phun tshogs= shing tog rtsa sngags/ oṃ ga ga ni ga ga ni bi lo ki te swā hā/ las sngags kyis phul te/ rigs rgyud chos rgyud= gzhan yang bsreg rdzas ci 'byor ba gtso sngags la/ badzra agni dzwa la raṃ spha ra ṇa pū dza khā hi/ zhes btags pas phul te 'don don gsol ba ni/ hoḥ bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon mchod rnams/ sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs/ byad phuragadon bgegs rims na nga*/ rmi talas mdzad ngan dus min 'chi/ 'jigs pa brgyad dang bcu drag sogs/ myur du zhi zhing mdor mdzadod/ ces gsol nas/ slar dgang blugs gsum phul nas/ ye shes me dang gnyis med 'bar ba yi/ phyag rgya chen po bsregs bya za ba'i zhal/ bsregs blugs bdud rtsi'i macod pas mnyes gyur nas/ zhi ba'i phrin las lhun gyis grub (593)par mdzod/ ces bskul bas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros pa sgrub bya la reg pas nad gdon dig sgrib thams cad zhi bar bsam/ des nas badzra wast+ra ye swā hā sa gos zung phul/ badzra tambu la ye swā hā/ so rtsi phul/ de nas gzhung gi sman mchod kyis sman 'bul/ gtor mchod kyis gtor ma 'bul/ raktos dmar macod 'bul/

de nas arghaṃ sogs kyis mchod cig bstod nas/ ma snyed yongs su ma tshang dang*/ sogs kyis bzod par gsol te yi ge brgya babazlas nas/ badzra muḥ sa*/ ye shes pa cos kyi dbyings su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rag la bstim nas mnyam par go/ de nas slar dgang gzar gyis mar khus me gsol te/ oṃ agni de wa ri ṣi ha bya ka bya kī bya bdag cag dpon slob sogs kyis bsregs lhag ma dang*/ oṃ badzra wa st+ra ye swā hā/ sogs oṃ badzra tambu la ye swā ha 'as tso rtsi 'bul/ oṃ gni ye de wa ri ṣi mhā ba lingta khā hi/ zhes gtor ma dang*/ lhā pañtsa amṛ ta rakata khā hi/ sman raka 'bul me ste bsregs bya (594)za ba po/ 'byung po'i rgyal po gdonagyi bdag shar lho me lha'i tshogs bcas la/ chod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ zhes bstagod cing yi ge brgya sa bzla te nongs pa bshags/ badzra muḥ sa me lha ye shes pa rang gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam la/ dge bsngo bkra shis rtsi rigs pas mtha' brgya par bya'o/ 'di ltar rta mgrin yang phyung nag po'i zhe ba'i phrin las dang 'brel ba'i sbyin bsregs kyi byang bu rgyud dang bla ma'i phyag bzhes kyis gsal ba kun dang mi 'gal zhing rgyud dang 'brale ba na'adi ni lha 'di'i byin rlabs kyi mtshan ma cung zad brnes pa sngags rigs dge blo rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po padma las 'brel rtsal gyis rang gnas ljon pa lung gi mtshams mal nas sug bris su bgyis pas 'gro kun srid pa'i 'jigs pa zhi ba'i rgyur gyur cig gu maṅga laṃ//
